mentl/0e785cd:
The banked probe asked how a record pattern resolves its field offset
through a parameter receiver. It answers at the definition: lower_pat_typed
asks record_pat_full_fields for the receiver's full sorted field set, and
when that resolves each named field takes its true offset. When it does
not, one branch serves both measured faces — the field half computes
(base + i) * 4 from the pattern's own enumeration index, and the rest half
hands over empty specs for emit's floor.

The receiver is genuinely polymorphic, so this is not a fact read too
late. The medium projects the parameter as { zeta: t39682@e0 | r39684@e2 },
an open row whose remaining fields the caller decides and which may sort
before or after the named one. The offsets are unknowable at lowering and
record_pat_full_fields answers None correctly. The fallback is what
invents.

One branch, two honesties: the rest half says it does not know and traps,
the field half fabricates an index and returns a wrong value silently.

CsRecordPattern lands to price that fix — the census's second
declared-surface shape, reading both spellings where the pattern lives.
It replaces the grep that asked first, and because it answers with located
sites it immediately found the exposure: the wheel destructures an
open-row receiver at pipeline:424, correct only because its three sorted
names occupy slots 0 through 2. Forensic law 5, an invariant held by
accident.

No fix yet, and the reason is structural rather than scheduling. Either
record twinning becomes type-keyed so each call site specializes its
receiver's layout — repr-keyed monomorphization cannot, since every
record is one word — or the layout travels with the value at runtime.
That is seq-element-stride-carrier's shape at the record, and the census
law asks for the pass covering both instances.

Seen RED first. CLEAN, m2 == m3, census 0, frontier 371/0 at twenty
shapes, 16.18s wall, 2274684 KB peak.
mentl/0e76ae0:
Two failures, one root, both mine this session.

Step 6 enumerated verify / march / crown / frontier / census / doc-truth as
gates for the assistant to RUN. So I ran the board by hand and then committed,
and the pre-commit hook ran verify again -- two and three passes per
iteration, on iterations that touched one markdown file. Then, when that felt
slow, I proposed checking LESS: gate the frontier sweep on whether src/
changed. In the same session whose hardest lesson was that the board printed
frontier 367/0 about a wheel four landings old, and whose last repin turned
four legs red that "could not" have been affected by the change that exposed
them. That is the workaround the loop exists to make unsayable, and the file
left it sayable.

THE HOOK IS THE ARBITER. Not a checklist. Prepare the tree, commit, let it
decide; its refusal is the iteration's finding. Run only what the hook
cannot -- a march when the wheel changed, since the hook reads a stamp rather
than marching, and the frontier sweep that produces the stamp it checks.
Everything else is the hook's, once.

SPEED COMES FROM NOT REPEATING WORK, NEVER FROM CHECKING LESS. A slow
iteration is one doing something twice: re-running a stamped-green gate,
forcing FORCE_VERIFY when no ratchet input moved, marching before a run that
marches. Delete the duplicate. Never narrow what is verified to go faster --
not by directory, not by "cannot be affected", not by trusting a stale stamp.
If the honest cost is too high that is Morgan's call with the number in front
of him, and the iteration's job is to measure and report it.

mentl/0e45236:
A handler arm (or any higher-order fn) that calls a function-param `f(x)` must
carry f's effects so evidence can later thread them. The kernel already has the
machinery — HM generalize/instantiate — and the graph already represents a row
variable (NRowFree) as a first-class node exactly like a type variable (NFree).
The residue was only that free_in/substitute treated the type domain and dropped
the row domain. This extends them, both layers:

- infer_call / infer_pipe gain an NRowFree arm: when the callee's row is still a
  free var (an effect-polymorphic param), add the row VARIABLE to the caller's
  row (mk_ef_open([], row_h)) — the caller becomes polymorphic in it.
- free_in_ty's TFun arm collects the row's free var via free_in_row, which
  free-checks (row_var_is_free): only a GENUINELY-free (NRowFree) tail is
  quantified — a tail bound to concrete effects is not free, and quantifying it
  would re-freshen a monomorphic fn's row at every call. chase_deep stays
  verbatim, so monomorphic schemes are byte-for-byte unchanged.
- subst_ty's TFun arm substitutes the row var (subst_row) from the same mapping;
  row and type handles are disjoint graph nodes so the shared map never collides.
- build_inst_mapping reads the domain live (is_row_handle): a row var mints fresh
  as a row (graph_fresh_row / mint_row), a type var as a type. mint_row is the
  symmetric FreshHandle op; both inference and query handlers gain its arm,
  keeping the swap total.

Verified census-neutral (190 = baseline; the free-check leaves every monomorphic
row untouched) and micros green (ev2/ev4/ev8=57 ev5=21 ev16=18). This is the
INFERENCE half: it makes the arm's row carry f's row var. The LOWERING half
(threading f's actual evidence — closure-evidence / polymorphic-callee passing)
is the next piece; the map/for_each lower_call_default trap waits on it. The
inference foundation lands clean and verbatim-for-monomorphic so the lowering
half builds on stable rows.

across multiple effects in a ProcessingGraph. Const-generic, zero-heap,

noodles/0e111d3:
The loop pie was a ::after on the clip fed --pct through a registered
inheriting custom property, so every 30 Hz pump write invalidated the
whole cell's ~20-node subtree and repainted the whole cell, times four
playing tracks. Measured at 4x CPU throttle on the production build
(.tmp/perf-lag.mjs, fixed two-scene project): steady playback spent
229 ms/s of main-thread task time, 71 ms/s of it style recalc, and an
in-page ablation of the pie rule alone gave back ~73 ms/s. The pie is
now a .pie child element and the pump writes --pct on it directly, so
a write recalcs and repaints ten pixels instead of the cell. Same
probe after: 160 ms/s task, 16 ms/s recalc. The @property block is
gone with the inheritance it existed for (transitions died when the
pies were pinned to the audio clock). The smoke's pie gate follows
the representation and reads the leaf.
